about_the_game: In this short demo for Puzzle Spy International, you’ll play Agent Epsilon in a small close-to-home mission set before the events of the main game. Work with Inspector Ewan Danger of Scotland Yard to decipher a challenging puzzle left by two Soviet agents. Fans of wordplay puzzles, Puzzled Pint, Puzzle Hunts, and the New York Times daily puzzles will enjoy this one-off spy adventure prelude to the main puzzle game.

short_description: Solve a tricky puzzle to track down Soviet Cypher Force agents in this stand-alone prelude to spy adventure Puzzle Spy International. As Agent Epsilon you’ll chat with (or chat up!) Inspector Ewan Danger and work to decode this substantial wordplay puzzle set in 1960's London.
